cycles_note: card cycles are nominal single-issue figures (1 = one pipeline cycle); memory and multiply/divide latencies are the machine's
delay_slots: a taken branch or jump executes the next instruction (its delay slot) before control moves; a branch-likely that is not taken skips its slot
name: mips32
sources: MIPS32 Architecture for Programmers, Volume II: The MIPS32 Instruction Set (Release 2)
public Allegrex (PSP CPU) instruction listings: the extra SPECIAL and SPECIAL3 encodings
statement: MIPS32 Release 2, little-endian, user-mode integer instructions, and the Sony Allegrex (the PlayStation Portable's CPU), a MIPS32 core with its own encodings for MADD/MSUB/CLZ/CLO, MIN/MAX, WSBW and BITREV and without SPECIAL2. Thirty-two 32-bit registers (r0 reads 0), HI and LO, branch delay slots. `variant` selects the core: 0 = MIPS32r2, 1 = Allegrex; a card marked arch mips32r2 or allegrex is undefined on the other. One card per instruction (registry isa, pack mips32). No FPU (COP1) or VFPU yet.
